sourceMappingEvidence: Inspected actual runtime contact sheet and full original status-board-01; visually matched motif, never inferred alphabetical slot order.
functionalMotif: One dark hooded figure with two cyan eyes peers from behind slate-purple cover rocks. One purple plant cluster at left and one teal plant cluster near lower center preserve the original supporting marks.
reconstructionCaveats: The original source fades its bottom rocks into an opaque backdrop. The redraw reconstructs a clean closed rock silhouette and simplifies plants to broad leaf sprays. No landscape extension or extra character is introduced; the figure remains hidden behind foreground cover. Native32 caveat: the cyan eyes are still very small details and are not as readable as at source512; acceptance relies on the clear hood, cover-rock and plant silhouette rather than claiming equal eye detail at both sizes.
postprocessing: Exact original reference crop only. Generated raw and master bytes are identical. No recolor, keying, alpha cleanup or pixel repainting. Whole-canvas resize only for separate QA derivatives.
catalogScope: C02 catalog-only source asset. No authored campaign consumer or live status integration is claimed.
